topic: Write about a Good Friend(介绍一位好朋友)
genre: 记叙 / 人物描写(describe a friend's looks and personality + why the friendship matters)
source: 外研社版必修第一册 Unit 4 Friends Forever:write about a good friend(描写朋友的外貌与性格 + 一件体现友谊的事 + 为什么珍惜这段友谊)。语言上自然运用定语从句(who/whose/that)。
prompt_cn: 假设你叫李华,学校英文报正在征集'My Best Friend'主题短文。请用英语写一篇约80词的短文,内容包括:① 简单介绍这位朋友(外貌或性格,如'a girl who is always smiling');② 讲一件体现你们友谊的小事;③ 说说你为什么珍惜这段友谊。注意:至少用两处定语从句(who/whose/that),句子地道、围绕中心。
prompt_en: Suppose you are Li Hua. Your school English newspaper is collecting short articles on the topic 'My Best Friend'. Write a passage of about 80 words including: 1) a short introduction to your friend (looks or personality, e.g. 'a girl who is always smiling'); 2) one small thing that shows your friendship; 3) why you value this friendship. Try to use at least two attributive clauses (who / whose / that).
points: 介绍朋友(My best friend is a boy/girl who … / whose …)
一件体现友谊的小事(I still remember the day … / the present that …)
为什么珍惜(She is the friend that I trust most because …)
至少两处定语从句、句子围绕中心、代词指代清楚
model_essay: My best friend is a girl called Mia, who is always smiling and ready to help. She is the kind of person who never lets a friend down. I still remember the day when I felt anxious before a big test. Mia, whose words are always warm, sat beside me and said, "Don't worry, I'm here." That small moment is something that I will never forget. She is the friend that I trust most, because true friendship, which money cannot buy, makes even ordinary days feel special.
model_translation: 我最好的朋友是个叫米娅的女孩,她总是面带微笑、乐于助人。她是那种从不让朋友失望的人。我仍记得有一次大考前我很焦虑,话语总是温暖的米娅坐到我身边说:"别担心,有我在。"那个小小的瞬间是我永远不会忘记的。她是我最信任的朋友,因为真挚的友谊——金钱买不到的东西——能让平凡的日子也变得特别。

rubric.criteria: 三要素齐全:介绍朋友 / 体现友谊的小事 / 珍惜的原因
围绕一位朋友展开、句句相关、代词指代清楚、行文连贯
至少两处定语从句(who/whose/that)运用得当、词汇句型准确多样、语法基本无误

required_structure: 介绍 My best friend is a … who …
细节 I still remember the day … / the present that …
性格 She is the kind of person who …
珍惜 She is the friend that I trust most because …
key_expressions: My best friend is a girl who is always smiling.
She is the kind of person who never lets a friend down.
That small moment is something that I will never forget.
True friendship, which money cannot buy, makes ordinary days feel special.

high_sentences: My best friend is a girl who is always smiling and ready to help.
She is the kind of person who never lets a friend down.
I still remember the day when I felt anxious before a big test.
She is the friend that I trust most, because true friendship makes ordinary days feel special.

error_pairs.wrong: She is a girl which is always smiling.
error_pairs.correct: She is a girl who is always smiling.
error_pairs.note: 先行词指人,用 who,不用 which。

error_pairs.wrong: Mia, who words are warm, helped me.
error_pairs.correct: Mia, whose words are warm, helped me.
error_pairs.note: 表所属(她的话语)用 whose,不用 who。

error_pairs.wrong: It is the only thing which matters.
error_pairs.correct: It is the only thing that matters.
error_pairs.note: 先行词被 the only 修饰,只用 that,不用 which。

paragraph_template:
【My Best Friend 结构】
第1句 介绍:My best friend is a … who … / whose …
第2-3句 小事:I still remember the day … She is the kind of person who …
第4句 珍惜:She is the friend that I trust most, because …
